title: Paying LIC Premiums Online: A Step-by-Step Guide
description: Paying your Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) premiums online offers unparalleled convenience, allowing payments anytime, anywhere. LIC provides multiple digit.

faq.q: Can I pay my LIC premium online without registering on the LIC portal?
faq.a: Yes, you can use the 'Pay Direct' option on the official LIC website, which allows you to pay renewal premiums and other dues without needing to log in or register.

faq.q: Are there any extra charges for paying LIC premiums online?
faq.a: No, LIC does not levy extra charges for online payments made via UPI, Debit Card, Net Banking, or Bharat QR Code. While credit card payments were historically subject to a convenience fee, LIC has waived these charges to promote digital transactions.

faq.q: How do I get a receipt after paying my LIC premium online?
faq.a: Upon successful online payment, an e-receipt is instantly generated and sent to your registered email ID. You can also download it from the 'View Transaction Status' section on the LIC website or from your customer portal.

faq.q: Can I pay premiums for multiple LIC policies in one transaction online?
faq.a: Yes, if you are a registered user on the LIC Customer Portal, you can typically add and manage multiple policies under your profile and pay their premiums in a single transaction.

faq.q: What if my account is debited but the payment status is not updated or I don't receive a receipt?
faq.a: If your account is debited but the receipt isn't generated, wait for up to 48 working hours. Often, the payment is processed, and the receipt is sent. If it's still unresolved, contact LIC support at bo_eps1@licindia.com with your policy number and transaction details.

faq.q: Can I pay my LIC premium in advance?
faq.a: Yes, you can pay your LIC premium in advance. Policyholders can deposit premiums up to the end of the current financial year. Additionally, premiums due in the next financial year can be paid up to three months in advance of their due date.

faq.q: Are all types of LIC policies eligible for online premium payment?
faq.a: Generally, online payment is available for ordinary 'in-force' policies and those eligible for spot revival. However, policies under the Salary Savings Scheme (SSS), ULIP, Health, and e-term plans are typically not eligible for online premium payments.
